baseline.label: A — baseline (smart_format + interim)
baseline.notes: Maps to Transcription style “Standard”. smart_format formats numbers, dates, and dollar amounts; interim partials on. Won Mac A/B — recommended default.

punctuate.label: B — punctuate only (no smart_format)
punctuate.notes: Maps to Transcription style “Lightweight”. Punctuation + capitalization only; numbers/dates stay as spoken words (no smart_format ITN).

punctuate_endpointing.label: C — punctuate + endpointing 300ms
punctuate_endpointing.notes: Same as B + endpointing 300. Mac A/B: worse than plain punctuate (line breaks felt off). Retained for reference only — not exposed as a Transcription style.
